display_title: Welcome to the Red Witch's Mansion
description:
Isabella, an ordinary commoner suddenly gets sacrificed by her village to the red witch. However when she meets this red witch, she soon noticed how oddly friendly she is.

Original Webtoon

***Note:** This series is self published series on Postype. It is not a serialized series at the moment and will have irregular updates. As of April 2023, the creator put the series on suspension due to them participating in a webtoon contest this coming year.*
